system.name: FeaSpect (Feature Spectrum learning)
system.one_liner: Remote-sensing change detection that removes pseudo-changes by a trainable spectrum transformation in feature space, with learnable extraction boxes.

content.variant_note: panels (a)-(d) show the pseudo-change, two prior fixes and the two drawbacks of the second; panel (e) shows the proposed fix
content.argues: GAN style transfer leaves artefacts, spectrum transformation has a mismatched space and a blind parameter search, and FeaSpect fixes both by matching the space and learning the search.
content.subject: A pair of aerial images with pseudo-change, how GANs and spectrum transformation align them, two abstract drawbacks of the latter, and the proposed method.

lessons.what_to_learn: Diagnose in lettered panels: show the same photos under each earlier method with coloured boxes on the failure regions, give each remaining drawback its own red-cross heading and a tiny schematic, then answer both in the last panel and end with a tick list.
lessons.suits: A paper that fixes a known two-part weakness of an existing technique and wants to show cause and cure in one figure.

evidence: Caption: (a) pseudo-change, (b) GAN results, (c) spectrum transformation results, (d) two drawbacks of ST, (e) FeaSpect.
Introduction: the two drawbacks are a limited transformation space and an inefficient parameter search.
Introduction: orange rectangles in (b) show artefacts; pink rectangles in (a) to (c) show lost semantic information.

summary: FeaSpect handles pseudo-changes in remote-sensing change detection by making the spectrum transformation trainable in feature space. Figure 1 is a problem-then-fix row of five lettered panels. (a) shows an aerial image pair with boxes on regions that only look different; (b) and (c) show the same photos after GAN and spectrum-transformation style alignment, with coloured rectangles on artefacts and lost detail; (d) holds two abstract drawbacks, a mismatched transformation space drawn as overlapping blobs and a blind hand-tuned search drawn as a star of trials; (e) shows the proposed box feeding a matched space and an adaptive search, trained by backpropagation, with a tick list and a dot key.
summary_zh: FeaSpect 用可训练的特征频谱变换消除遥感变化检测中的伪变化。图中五个字母分栏：同一对航拍图依次展示伪变化、GAN与频谱变换的结果、频谱变换的两个缺陷，最后一栏给出方法、反向传播箭头和打勾清单。
notes: Panel titles are only in the caption; the figure carries letters. The mapping of blob colours to pixel space and task space is not stated, so the blobs are described as two overlapping spaces. The bottom caption text is partly cropped into the preview and was ignored.
